newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico hotels in Alestra long-distance phone deal.
newsitem.headline: Mexico hotels in Alestra long-distance phone deal.

text.p: The Mexican Hotel and Motel Association (AMHM) said on Tuesday it had signed a deal with new long-distance carrier Alestra.

The AMHM, which numbers 1,600 members, reached its decision at a general assembly held in January after weighing nine competitors in Mexico's newly opened long-distance telephone market, AMHM President Alfredo Tinajero said at a news conference.
January 1 saw an end to the decades old monopoly previously enjoyed by Telefonos de Mexico.
Alestra is a joint venture between AT&T Corp, Mexican industrial conglomerate Alfa SA and financial group VISA-BANCOMER, an affiliate of Grupo Financiero Bancomer SA de CV.
Under the terms of the agreement, Alestra will provide voice, data and video transmission services, in addition to carrying domestic and international long-distance calls.
